name: Naoe Hasumi
source: Joins in the earth route. Master of the dark type guardian Kanetsugu. Was Yukari's mentor on how to use a guardian. She allows herself to get captured at the start of the game in order to allow Yui to escape during one of Egubado's attacks.
translation: Joins in the earth route. Master of the dark type guardian Kanetsugu. Was Yukari's mentor on how to use a guardian. She allows herself to get captured at the start of the game in order to allow Yui to escape during one of Egubado's attacks.
